integrity: No independent validation or priority certification is claimed; arithmetic tests run in a finite field, and only observed full modular rank certifies full rational rank.
scientific_limitations: The complete theorem assumes uniform positive spoke weights, unit rim weights and independently driven vertices, not generic weights or common-input actuation. The Fourier spectra and PBH tools are known, and unindexed specialist literature may affect publication priority. Finite rational modular tests do not prove the all-parameter theorem; its proof is analytic.
title: Minimum coordinate control of weighted wheel Laplacians: exact coupling resonances and placements
